title: NEAR Intents Adds Confidential Cross Chain Swaps to CircuitAI
summary:
Trading bots on the Circuit platform can now perform on-chain actions using simple text instructions. Through an integration with NEAR Intents, these autonomous agents can execute cross-chain swaps and transfers via the Circuit Terminal. Users can specify actions with a single sentence, such as swapping 0.05 ETH on Arbitrum to SOL or moving 50 USDC from Base to a Solana wallet.

The update allows transactions to be performed as Confidential Intents by adding the word 'privately' to a command to mask on-chain movements that often serve as tradeable signals for other market participants. The integration became live on October 9, 2026, enabling these agents to handle multi-chain transactions without manual bridge processes.
